Physiognomically regarded, the Sperm Whale is an anomalous creature.

reference.text: In some particulars, perhaps the most imposing physiognomical view to be had of the Sperm Whale, is that of the full front of his head.

reference.text: In profile, you plainly perceive that horizontal, semi-crescentic depression in the forehead’s middle, which, in man, is Lavater’s mark of genius.
